profile.headline: Software Engineer | Java | .NET Core | PL/SQL | Team Player
profile.summary: Results-driven Software Engineer with over 7 years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-level software solutions. Motivated team player eager to contribute expertise to a dynamic team, driving innovation and achieving business success.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed and tested an innovative process for identifying and processing client accounts
compliant with the Foreign Account Tax Compliance (FATCA).
* Created front-end features for customers to modify their preferences and add/edit payments for an
insurance company in Puerto Rico.
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Programming · RESTFul APIs · Unix · Systems Design · Design Patterns · Java Development · Oracle Database · Linux · Spring Framework · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET Core · Docker · PL/SQL · GitHub · Jenkins · JUnit · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · C# · Microsoft Azure · PHP · Mockito · Git · Java · Maven · Microservices · Problem Solving

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Engineered, from conception to launch, a RESTful API for the integration of the in-house CRM
system with the third-party grocery delivery application to keep inventory and prices up to date.
* Designed and implemented features such as ordering systems, inventory, and supply chain in the
in-house CRM system.
* Analyzed database objects to pinpoint performance issues, employing advanced querying
techniques and optimization strategies to enhance responsiveness.
* Implemented and maintained source control repositories such as Git and Bitbucket for versioning
purposes.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Programming · RESTFul APIs · Unix · Systems Design · SOAP · Design Patterns · Java Development · Agile Project Management · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Oracle Database · Linux · Spring Framework · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Microsoft SQL Server · PL/SQL · GitHub · Bootstrap (Framework) · Jira · JUnit · REST APIs · Git · Java · Maven · Problem Solving · Shell Scripting

positions.title: System Engineer IV
positions.description:
* Engineered a robust application crucial for the integration of the in-house CRM system with the
newer Huawei’s telecommunication platform.
* Developed and tested a robust server/socket application capable of efficiently handling more than
1000 TPS, leading to a 25% increase in overall system efficiency, enhancing performance and
reliability.
* Designed and implemented a Java-based corporate customer mass activation program,
streamlining processes and significantly improving the efficiency of the customer service
department, directly contributing to enhancing customer satisfaction and retention.
* Successfully executed the migration of legacy Java applications, addressing performance issues
and reducing response times by an impressive 35%, resulting in enhancing system
responsiveness and user satisfaction.
* Collaborated with the finance department to develop reports aligned with IFRS 14 standards.

positions.title: System Engineer III
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the finance department to develop financial reports aligned with IFRS 14 standards, increasing company profits by 10%.
• Successfully executed the migration of legacy Java applications, addressing performance issues and reducing response times by and impressive 50%, resulting in enhancing system responsiveness and user satisfaction.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Designed and tested regional solutions for investment fund managers, including customer
software tools and applications, resulting in measurable improvement in customer satisfaction and
operational efficiency.
* Implemented performance optimization strategies for PL/SQL code, including query optimization
and indexing techniques, resulting in a significant increase in server efficiency by 30%.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · HTML · RESTFul APIs · Unix · Systems Design · SOAP · Design Patterns · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Oracle Database · Linux · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · PL/SQL · GitHub · Bootstrap (Framework) · Jira · REST APIs · Git · Java · HTML5 · Problem Solving · Shell Scripting

positions.title: Billing Engineer
positions.description:
• Managed rate plans, tariffs, and pricing structures for various telecommunications services, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and business objectives.
• Configured and maintained billing systems and software to accurately capture and process customer usage data, service activations, and billing information.
• Analyzed billing data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for revenue optimization or cost reduction, and providing insights to management for decision-making.

honors.title: Graduated with honors from Phi Theta Kappa
honors.description: I graduated with honors from Phi Theta Kappa, a prestigious honor society recognizing academic excellence and leadership in community colleges. This achievement highlights my commitment to scholarship, service, and personal growth.
honors.issuer: Issued by Phi Theta Kappa - Honor Society · May 2024

honors.title: Excellence Awards 2020
honors.description: I was honored to have received the gold star award in the corporate category for my significant contribution to the integration and adoption project of our company's 5G technology, alongside the successful migration of clients to new network nodes. This achievement underscored my dedication to driving technological innovation and ensuring seamless transitions within our organization, collaborating closely with a talented team, we effectively implemented cutting-edge solutions that positioned the company at the forefront of the telecommunications industry.

volunteerExperiences.description: This opportunity is a rewarding experience to assist community members with their technology needs. I'm passionate about making technology accessible to everyone and empowering people to navigate today's digital world confidently. This opportunity allows me to give back to the community and further develop my own skills while making a meaningful impact.
